name: net_checkpoint_kept_only_if_agreed
description: Three clients. Each flags its HASH at checkpoint ticks (every 1,800 ticks, and the first hash tick after a horn) and keeps its own serialized state there, the last two only, whose digest is the hash it sent. Client 1's uploads reach the sequencer with one byte flipped: whenever it is asked (in rotation), its upload's digest is not the agreed hash, so the sequencer drops it and asks the next seat, whose upload it keeps. Every checkpoint kept has the agreed hash as its digest, the sequencer keeps the last two, and no upload of client 1 was ever kept.

steps.msg: six checkpoints were uploaded and kept
client 1 (wire seat 0) was asked and every upload of its was dropped: its digest was not the agreed hash
each dropped tick was asked of the next seat and kept from it
every checkpoint kept has the agreed hash as its digest, and the sequencer keeps two
every flagged tick is a multiple of 1,800 or the first hash tick after a horn
a client keeps its last two checkpoints, each with the digest it sent as its hash
the corrupted uploads changed no hash
